amounts.first_ask_multi: Can you pay all of them today?

identity.fail_say: Please use the mobile app or a branch.

third_party.condolence: I am sorry for your loss.

sentences.opening: I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded. Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?
sentences.id_fail: I could not verify your identity. Please use the mobile app or a branch.
sentences.id_swapped: Please say the month as a word.
sentences.disclosure_intro: I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.
sentences.first_ask_single: Can you make this payment today?
sentences.first_ask_multi: Can you pay all of them today?
sentences.after_promise: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
sentences.below_floor: That amount cannot be recorded. Can you pay {floor}?
sentences.paid_reply: Payments can take one business day to appear.
sentences.scam_reply: You can verify the call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
sentences.robot_reply: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
sentences.no_info: I do not have that information.
sentences.change_in_app: This cannot be changed in this call. You can change it in the mobile app.
sentences.sympathy: I am sorry to hear that.
sentences.support_offer: Would you like me to connect you with the customer support team?
sentences.deceased: I am sorry for your loss.

interrupts.hardship: mention illness, a death in the family or job loss
interrupts.support_offer: Offer to connect them with the customer support team
interrupts.dispute: "This debt is not mine", "I never had this product", or a claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past
interrupts.paid_say: say that payments can take one business day to appear
interrupts.restructuring: a request for a new payment plan or lower instalments
interrupts.scam_say: say they can verify the call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number
interrupts.robot_say: say that you are Freya Bank's digital assistant
interrupts.no_info_say: say you do not have that information
interrupts.change_say: say they can change it in the mobile app
